description: Transparent deterministic scenario factors applied to the Step 6 display-depth baseline. This is not a radar nowcast.
notes: T+0 is the existing Step 6 display-depth raster.
Future horizons apply a reproducible persistence/decay scenario to the baseline.
A Doppler Weather Radar provider can replace this scenario without changing downstream contracts.
Factors are research assumptions and are not calibrated hydraulic or meteorological parameters.
